{{Top|leg}}
The '''''Himner''''' was a pair of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]]s that were part of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] [[Admiral Harkov's fleet]] that defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] the transports attempted to attack the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] [[Harpax]]. Both were destroyed in the battle.
